$schema: Technology eras + research (spec §10). Knowledge (a resource, accrued via base income + libraries) is spent to complete techs. type:'era' advances the civ's era, unlocking that era's buildings (see buildings.json era field). type:'bonus' grants a permanent civ-wide modifier read by the relevant system. requires gates a tech behind another. Not every path is forced: era techs are the spine, bonus techs are optional side investments (spec §10).
